_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Re-encodes heavy draft images to WebP at the same address; the replaced file is kept under .originals (never served). Your live site shows the smaller file after you publish (some imported files sooner).

description: Shrink heavy images in place (0.98): JPEG/PNG/still GIF → WebP at the same address, so no HTML changes. keys = site paths from verify_page health.assets[].ref — /assets/… uploads or clone paths like /wp-content/… (1–50 per call; batch keys from several entries). Skips animated images, already-small files and non-images (`skipped`); idempotent. The replaced file is kept under .originals (never served). Spends the daily image budget like an upload — dryRun:true reports the saving without spending it. The draft serves the smaller file at once. Your live site shows the smaller file after you publish (some imported files sooner).

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

dryRun.description: Report before/after sizes only; writes nothing and spends no budget.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

keys.description: Site paths of the images, e.g. /assets/hero.jpg or /wp-content/uploads/photo.png.

name: optimize_assets
